title: RANK versus DENSE_RANK
statement:
Table scores(player TEXT, points INTEGER) contains:
  ('a', 100)
  ('b', 100)
  ('c', 90)
  ('d', 80)

SELECT player,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC),
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC)
FROM scores;

What are the RANK() and DENSE_RANK() values on player c's row?
